posts.title: Plausibility Is Not Truth
posts.description: A couple of years ago, I received a phone call while I was in a meeting. It was my mother. I left the meeting to take the call. After asking if I had a few moments to spare, she calmly told me that she thought she had found a hand grenade. Once I had recovered from my initial shock, she asked me what to do next. posts.title: How Long Does It Take to Learn TDD? Longer Than You Think, And That's Fine
posts.description: I always struggle to come up with a good answer when I’m asked how long it takes to learn Test-Driven Development. Even providing a rough estimate is very difficult. Test-Driven Development is probably the most difficult Extreme Programming practice to learn (and teach). I always say that it will take at least six months.
